title: Tests for white noise via asymptotically independent U-statistics in high-dimensions
summary: Existing tests for high-dimensional white noise are tailored to the two ends of the sparsity spectrum: maximum-type statistics excel against a few dominant correlations and sum-type statistics against many weak ones, leaving the intermediate regime without a systematic tool. We propose a family of $U$-statistics built from the entry-wise $\ell_a$-norms of the sample autocovariance matrices, in which the even order $a$ interpolates between the sum-type ($a=2$) and maximum-type ($a\to\infty$) endpoints.
